collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: Life is going well but a villager keeps waiting for something to go wrong: talk about it, or try to enjoy it anyway.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Everything has been going well lately. Good harvest, everyone healthy, the roof finally stopped leaking. And (subject) can't enjoy any of it, because (subject.he/she) is waiting for something to go wrong. Things don't stay this good. Surely. (friend) finds (subject.him/her) sitting outside, frowning at a perfectly nice sunset.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "What if it all goes wrong?" says (subject). "It might," says (friend). "Something will, eventually. That's how it works." (subject) stares at (friend.him/her). "That's not comforting." "No. But this is still a nice sunset." They watch it together. (subject) still worries. (subject.He/she) also, for a while, watches the sunset.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) makes (subject.him/her)self look at the sunset. Really look. It's orange and pink and gold. (subject.He/she) is still waiting for something to go wrong. Nothing does, tonight. (subject.He/she) goes to bed with the worry and the sunset both still in (subject.his/her) head. Some nights it's like that.
